description_en: Sends shell control instructions to a cloud application service instance. This operation supports both sync and asynchronous command responses. The sync scenario is not suitable for time-consuming commands. The maximum execution time cannot exceed 30 s. In an asynchronous scenario, you can call the GetRenderingInstanceCommandsStatus operation to query the execution status and result of a command
description_zh:
向一个云应用服务实例下发shell控制指令，支持同步/异步响应命令。
同步场景，不适用于耗时命令（最大耗时不能超过30s）。
异步场景，可通过GetRenderingInstanceCommandsStatus接口查询命令执行状态与结果
kebab_example: aliyun vs send-rendering-instance-commands --rendering-instance-id render-9f8c57355d224ad7beaf95e145f22111 --commands date_ls_-l_/tmp --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendRenderingInstanceCommands

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud application service instance
parameters.name: rendering_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
A shell command string. Enter multiple commands separated by semicolons (;) or line feeds.

Dangerous commands such as rm and reboot are disabled
parameters.help_zh:
shell命令字符串。支持输入多条命令，以";"/换行符分隔，

禁用rm/reboot等危险命令
parameters.name: commands

parameters.help_en:
The response pattern for the command. Valid values:

Sync: The response is returned synchronously. This is the default value.

Async: The response is returned asynchronously
parameters.help_zh:
命令响应模式，取值范围：
Sync：同步响应。默认值。
Async：异步响应
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for command execution, in seconds. The value range depends on the Mode parameter:

If Mode is set to Sync, the value range is 0 to 30. The default value is 30.

If Mode is set to Async, the value range is 0 to 3600. The default value is 300
parameters.help_zh:
命令执行的超时时间，单位秒。取值范围与Mode响应模式取值有关：
Mode=Sync，0-30，默认30
Mode=Async，0-3600，默认300
parameters.name: timeout

CmdId.description_en: The unique ID of the command request. The ID is valid for one day by default. In asynchronous scenarios, if you need the result, query it promptly within the validity period, preferably before the command times out
CmdId.description_zh: 命令请求的唯一ID。默认1天内有效，对于异步场景，对结果有关注的情况，建议在有效时间内尽快查询结果（最好在命令执行超期时间内）
CmdId.title_en: Unique ID of the command request. By default, it is valid for 1 day. For asynchronous scenarios where you need to follow up on the result, we recommend querying the result as soon as possible within the validity period (preferably before the command execution timeout).
CmdId.title_zh: 命令请求的唯一ID。默认1天内有效，对于异步场景，对结果有关注的情况，建议在有效时间内尽快查询结果（最好在命令执行超期时间内）。

Result.description_en: The result of the command response
Result.title_en: 命令的执行结果字符串
Result.title_zh: 命令的执行结果字符串
